access_groups.description: Knovas RBAC access-group identifiers assigned to every document ingested from this source. Passed through to /secured/init_document_transmission, which materialises the ACL at ingest, so documents from a walled folder are born walled rather than repaired afterwards. Omit for unrestricted folders; an empty array is treated as omitted. Identifiers are resolved by the Secure API inside the caller's own tenant and fail the request closed if unknown (GI-ACCESSROLES-04).

fields.description: Static Knovas field values for every document of this source, keyed by registry key; sent as init `fields` (upload layer). Entity values are names. Omit when empty.

field_templates.description: Source-relative path templates, e.g. "{client}/{period}/**". First match wins; captures become field values. Golden vectors: contracts/vectors/field_templates.json.

metadata_fields.description: Extractor metadata items mapped into upload fields for this source, each one opted into by the administrator. Mapped keys are never registered automatically. keywords and document_status need the capability metadata_fields_v2. Golden vectors: contracts/vectors/metadata_fields.json.

include_globs.description: Glob patterns for files to sync. Default (when omitted) includes .md, .txt, .docx, .pdf, .eml, .msg. Binary types are converted to Markdown for ingest; identifiers keep the original path/extension for open/download in KnovasPlatform.

fieldScalar.description: One field value: a string (money as text, e.g. "CHF 1234.50"; entities as names), a number or a boolean. Never an object.
